reason: A completed turn ends with the deliverables its final reply and its own edits name: cited or linked documents as file cards, otherwise the one local server the reply names, otherwise the one HTML page the turn edited. Internet links are citations and never become resources; an unfinished turn has none.

projection.name: internet links in prose are citations, not resources
one local server with a port is a website resource
two different local servers are ambiguous
a local address without a port is not a started server
trailing punctuation is not part of the address and repeats collapse
subdomains of localhost count as local
one edited HTML page is a website resource
two edited HTML pages produce no website
the conversation's own inline visualization page is not a deliverable
a server address outranks an edited page
a linked document is a file resource and replaces any website
linked file types are limited to documents
relative links resolve against the working directory and deduplicate
a link wrapped in a code span still counts
links inside fenced code do not count
image embeds are not file resources
citation directives admit the wider output set
an unfinished turn has no resources

coverage.name: files the cards present hide the changed-files card
a markdown file card does not stand in for its diff
a page website covers its own edit only
a server website covers no file

linkLines.name: a bullet that only links a card's file is dropped
a sentence around the link stays
linkLines.text: The report is at [report.pdf](/work/out/report.pdf) for review.
linkLines.expected: The report is at [report.pdf](/work/out/report.pdf) for review.

card.websiteIcon: page icon from a data image or a sibling image file up to 256 KiB, otherwise the website glyph
card.websiteSubtitle: Website; on row hover Open (file page or in-app local URL) or Open in <browser> / default browser with an external mark
card.websiteTrailing: split Open in button: primary opens like the row, chevron opens the menu
websiteMenu: applications that handle the URL or file, at most 5, default first
Copy link (local URL only, after a separator)
card.fileSubtitle: type name (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, ...), the directory for an unnamed type; Open preview on row hover
fileMenu: applications for the file, at most 5, (Default) for Office documents
separator, Show in Finder / File Explorer / File Manager
